title: Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE

entities.name: RRCSetup
entities.description: RRC connection setup message received by the UE from the network to establish an RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCSetupComplete
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to complete the RRC connection setup procedure.

entities.name: UE Inactive AS Context
entities.description: Stored AS context information for the UE in RRC_INACTIVE state, which is discarded upon RRCSetup reception in certain conditions.

entities.name: AS Security Context
entities.description: Current AS security context including KRRCenc, KRRCint, KUPint, and KUPenc keys, which is discarded upon RRCSetup reception in certain conditions.

entities.name: Timer T380
entities.description: Timer related to UE inactivity or context management, stopped if running upon RRCSetup reception.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer for access category barring, stopped for all access categories upon RRCSetup reception.

entities.name: Timer T302
entities.description: Timer for RRC connection establishment, stopped upon RRCSetup reception.

entities.name: Timer T320
entities.description: Timer related to cell reselection priorities, stopped if running upon RRCSetup reception.

entities.name: Timer T331
entities.description: Timer related to RRC connection resume, stopped upon RRCSetup reception in response to RRCResumeRequest.

entities.name: PCell
entities.description: Primary cell considered by the UE as the serving cell after RRCSetup reception.

entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: Variable storing radio link failure or handover failure information, updated upon RRCSetup reception under specific conditions.

entities.name: Cell Reselection Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for cell reselection in idle/inactive mode, stopped upon RRCSetup reception.

relations.description: Reception of RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest leads to discarding stored UE Inactive AS context.
Reception of RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest leads to discarding current AS security context.
Reception of RRCSetup stops timer T380 if running.
Reception of RRCSetup stops timer T390 for all access categories.
Reception of RRCSetup stops timer T302.
Reception of RRCSetup stops timer T320 if running.
Reception of RRCSetup in response to RRCResumeRequest stops timer T331.
Reception of RRCSetup leads the UE to consider the current cell as the PCell.
Reception of RRCSetup stops the cell reselection procedure.
Reception of RRCSetup under specific conditions updates VarRLF-Report with reconnection time and cell identity.
Reception of RRCSetup leads to the UE setting the content of and submitting the RRCSetupComplete message.
